Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestPaxChronology_test_Chronology_eraOf_invalid.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestPaxChronology/TestPaxChronology_test_Chronology_eraOf_invalid.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original test has one tiny test method buried under ~50 lines of unused data provider methods and dozens of unused imports. I'll strip all of that noise and keep only what the test actually exercises.Compiles successfully. I reduced the test from ~115 lines of mostly-unused data providers and 40+ imports down to a focused 26-line test: removed all dead `data_*` methods and unused imports, gave the test method an intention-revealing name, and added a comment explaining why `2` is an invalid era — while preserving the exact runtime behavior (`PaxChronology.INSTANCE.eraOf(2)` expecting `DateTimeException`).
